item.title: Mountain Manor Disc Golf Course - Pigeon Forge, Tennessee
item.description: Mountain Manor Disc Golf Course. Public pay-to-play course on private land. Established in 2023. Permanently closed after November 22, 2025 because of health and age-related issues. Very hilly with significant elevation change; carts are not recommended.

item.title: Mountain Manor DGC
item.description: 2792 Happy Hollow Road, Sevierville, Tennessee 37862. Pay to play. Course and trail network on a very hilly, moderately wooded former tobacco farm. Year established: 2023.
